references.text: The warning against rebelling against the Lord and turning away from him is also found here, where the people are urged not to rebel against the Lord.
God's anger over the entire congregation because of one man's sin, as Joshua warns that God's wrath will strike the whole community of Israel.
The Lord's anger was kindled against Israel when the people sinned, illustrating the consequence of turning away from the Lord.
Achan's sin led to the Lord's anger being kindled against the entire community of Israel, a concrete example of what Joshua warns against.
The same context in which the tribes are accused of turning away from the Lord today.
The tribes defend themselves and say they will not rebel against the Lord or turn away from him.
